abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 6. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 52 | 300 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 69 | 300 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 35 | 300 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 85 | 300 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
